name: Aikawa Miyuu
source:
A popular fortune teller and first-year high school student with her own fanclub at school. She has recently decided to get close to [url=/c55837]Yuuta[/url], joining him and [url=/c55162]Ryouka[/url] to contribute to his blog. They all live in Kichijouji and go to the same school.

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Occultic;Nine]Wikipedia[/url]]
